title: agarista oleifolia var. glabra
intro: Agarista oleifolia var. glabra, commonly known as Smooth Agarista, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Smooth Agarista are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiseptic properties, which help in reducing swelling, fighting infections, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
